searchText: `v0.8.2` -- Prototypical Testing -- released! https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/releases/tag/v0.8.2 Updated test vectors to follow <mratsim> Needs Lambda testing now ;) Haha, hope everyone is happy with the changes distilled from the survey results. It definitely helps testing speed, lowers resource requirements (no enormous files) and allows you to shift away from yaml when loading SSZ data. would it be necessary to run `on_attestation` for the attestations in the beacon -block? https://github.com/ethereum/eth2.0-specs/blob/dev/specs/core/0_fork-choice.md#on_attestation thinking out loud, how unlikely it is to *not* have received the aggregated attestation over the wire, but these attestations somehow contained in the block....
